## Install
Download the installer for your computer below — no Miniconda or Python needed.

| Computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (64-bit) | `ChATlas-…-Windows-x86_64.exe` |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1–M4…) | `ChATlas-…-MacOSX-arm64.pkg` |
| Mac with Intel processor | `ChATlas-…-MacOSX-x86_64.pkg` |

The installers are not code-signed yet:
- **Windows**: if SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS**: if it says the package can't be checked, **right-click the .pkg → Open**, or allow it in *System Settings → Privacy & Security*.

After installing: open **Settings**, paste your CAVE token and click **Save token**.
